rv.q: Gold seems to have told 007 and company to act detached and indifferent in this oh-so-violent and propulsive of works.
This 'Macbeth' struck me as a bit bloodless.

cn.t: Critics find this "Macbeth" bloodless despite its gore, with detached performances that drain Shakespeare's violent tragedy of its power and emotion under direction prioritizing visual spectacle over compelling acting.

vs.sum: The Music Box Theatre offers excellent sightlines from most seats, making it ideal for intimate dramas, though sound quality can vary. The theater's charming Georgian-inspired design adds to its ambiance, while comfort and facilities are average for a Broadway venue.

acc.note: 5 wheelchair spaces in Orchestra. No steps from sidewalk. Infrared devices available.
